attacks.name: Concussion Blasters
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Nano-Corruption|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§poison§Poison| and |§bleed§Bleed| special conditions.

attacks.name: Extinction Protocols
steps: Before |!damage| is dealt, if the target character is |!size| 4 or less, this character Throws it |!movement_small|.

|!wild| |*Explosive Force|: After this attack is resolved, other characters within |!range| 2 of this character are Pushed Away from this character |!movement_small|. Pushed characters suffer 1 |!damage|.

superPowers.name: Kinetic Field Generator
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 4 or less within |!range| 3 and Throw it |!movement_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Encephalo-Beam
superPowers.body: Choose an enemy character within |!range| 3 and Advance it |!movement_small|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Metal Mind
superPowers.body: When this character is defending against a |!mystic| attack, count each |!wild| in the defense roll as 2 successes. Additionally, this character cannot be Pushed or Advanced by the special rules of |!mystic| attacks or enemy superpowers.

superPowers.name: I Will Create a Better Age
superPowers.body: When a terrain feature is destroyed by an allied effect, if there is not an allied |£ultron-drones-grunts£&*Ultron Drones&| in play, you may place an |£ultron-drones-grunts£&*Ultron Drones&| into play within |!range| 3 of this character. It gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition and is part of your Squad.
